fields.description: Sera 2 brings apartments and three bedroom townhouses to Rashid Yachts & Marina. The homes are arranged around a landscaped water garden, with leisure spaces connecting the buildings to the marina setting. Sand-coloured surfaces, blue glazing and champagne accents form the proposed exterior palette.
amenities: Paddle court as described in fact sheet

overview: The proposed landscape is a central part of Sera 2: a water garden and leisure pool sit alongside places for exercise, play and quieter outdoor time. The brochure places these shared spaces within the wider marina neighbourhood, where cafés, shops and waterfront walks contribute to the setting. The townhouse layouts introduce a two-level alternative to the apartments. Buyers should separate facilities within the residential development from attractions in the surrounding masterplan when checking access and charges.
research.locationNote: Sera 2 is within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid. The brochure positions the development in relation to the marina promenade and landscaped water garden. Views, pedestrian access and travel times depend on the building and selected home; waterfront positioning does not establish an included berth.
research.priceNote: Emaar lists units from AED 2,112,888. The launch fact sheet gives rounded starting figures of AED 2.1m for one bedroom, AED 3.1m for two, AED 4.3m for three and AED 7.2m for a townhouse. These are published reference figures, not confirmation of current stock or a quotation.
research.paymentNote: The Sera 2 launch schedule totals 80% before completion and 20% at estimated completion. Several early dates have passed. A present purchase needs the selected unit’s current payment statement, including any instalments already due.
research.handoverNote: The payment sheet gives November 2029 as estimated construction completion, corroborated by Property Finder. Confirm contractual delivery and the latest progress with the developer.

facts.label: Published residential mix
facts.value: 183 homes: 86 one bedroom, 77 two bedroom and 12 three bedroom apartments, plus eight townhouses. These are launch totals, not remaining availability.

facts.label: Townhouse layout
facts.value: Type A2 places three bedrooms upstairs, with living and dining spaces, a separate maid’s room, laundry and storage below. Units 02, 06 and 08 show a 2,190.56 sq ft suite plus 363.71 sq ft balcony; the printed total is 2,554.28 sq ft, with a 0.01 sq ft rounding difference.
